create.name: Bristol School of Yoga
create.bio:
Bristol School of Yoga is a teaching studio and teacher-training school in a converted building on Backfields Lane, close to Stokes Croft in central Bristol. It is directed by Laura Gilmore, who leads its trainings and has shaped its approach: respect for the classical roots of yoga, read alongside what modern study of the body and mind has to say. Its courses move between alignment and anatomy on one side and the subtle body, the chakras and vayus, meditation and the Yoga Sutras on the other, and the school describes its take on philosophy as down to earth and non-dogmatic.

The school has run a 200-hour training for some seventeen years. It currently offers it in two strands, Hatha with Restorative and Vinyasa with Yin, taught over several months of weekend days with home study, practice teaching and assessment, and certified with YogaPros UK. Graduates can continue to a 300-hour advanced course. For students not yet ready to train, Yoga in Depth spends eight Sundays across the year on posture families, breathing practice, meditation, yoga nidra and philosophy, with the option to join from home by video. A weekly timetable of studio classes runs alongside, with monthly memberships and class passes.

courses.title: Vinyasa and Yin 200hr Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: The school's 200-hour course in flowing and slow, held practice, running from April to October 2027 in Bristol with a live online option. It covers asana and adjustment, meditation and pranayama, philosophy from the key texts, anatomy, observed and assessed teaching, and setting up as a teacher.

courses.title: Yoga in Depth
courses.description: Eight Sunday study days spread over the year, each led by one of the school's teachers, on posture families, rest and yoga nidra, meditation, pranayama and the Yoga Sutras. It can be joined at the studio or by video, with recordings afterwards, and suits students weighing up teacher training.

courses.title: Earth Membership
courses.description: A monthly studio membership giving nine classes a month and a discount on in-house workshops. Larger memberships, drop-in classes and class passes are on the same page.
